messages.2:
BRAM: I GAVE THE SUN KEY TO CORA.
AT SIX I SAW HER HOLD THE PAGE.
I LEFT THEN. SHE STILL HAS IT.
messages.11:
CORA: I TOOK IT. NOW I RETURN IT.
YOU SEE THE PAGE RETURNED AT SEVEN.
COMPARE BRAM. WHY DO ACCOUNTS DIFFER?
8 NOW CHOOSES WHY. Q CAN SHOW BRAM.
messages.12:
CORA USED THE KEY. BRAM LEFT AT SIX.
HE DID NOT SEE THE RETURN AT SEVEN.
HIS OLD ACCOUNT WAS NOT A NEW LIE.
YOU EXPLAIN THE DIFFERENCE. EXIT OPEN.
messages.13:
BRAM: CORA STILL HAS THE PAGE.
I SAW HER AT SIX AND LEFT THEN.
I HAVE HEARD NOTHING SINCE.
COMPARE THAT WITH WHAT YOU SAW.
messages.14:
BRAM: YOU SHOWED ME THE RETURN.
BEFORE THAT I THOUGHT CORA HAD IT.
I SAW HER AT SIX AND LEFT THEN.
I DID NOT SEE THE RETURN AT SEVEN.
messages.15:
YOU SHOW BRAM THE RETURNED PAGE.
HE LEARNS WHAT HE DID NOT OBSERVE.
ASK HIM ABOUT HIS EARLIER ACCOUNT.
messages.16:
YOU SAW THE RETURN. ASK BRAM AGAIN.
COMPARE HIS OPPORTUNITY TO KNOW
BEFORE EXPLAINING THE DIFFERENCE.
messages.17:
COMPLETE ENTRY: ROUND SQUARE TRIANGLE.
THE LEDGER PAGE IS NOW BACK.
YOU SAW CORA RETURN IT AT SEVEN.
THE OLD STUB MATCHES HER ENVELOPE.
messages.18:
CORA: MY FIRST DENIAL WAS FALSE.
I TOOK THE PAGE THEN RETURNED IT.
YOU SAW ME RETURN IT AT SEVEN.
BRAM HAD ALREADY LEFT AT SIX.
